results.title: A session saved with status "complete" (what finishSession writes) is counted by recentSessions(7)
Legacy status "completed" with completedAt remains counted (compatibility)
Drafts are never counted; window boundaries respected (7 vs 42 days)
Complete sessions with missing, invalid or future-garbage dates do not throw and are not miscounted
Empty / malformed pa_sessions_v2 values return zero without throwing
End-to-end: a session finished through the real finishSession() flows into Training Budget and Coach Handoff
The fix does not mutate stored sessions (read-only compatibility)

Training Budget classification is exact: "athletic" counts only as Explosive + Capability and "mobility" only as Low-intensity engine, never as Strength or Hypertrophy (corrected assertion; the original defect assertion is preserved in tests/historical/)
Steady Leg Press 300x8 on 3 dates followed by one Widowmaker 200x20 is NOT flagged ACT/INVESTIGATE
Progressing leg curl followed by ONE light day is not flagged
Progressing paused-bench method followed by a single back-off-only day is not flagged
Records of different strength methods for the same exercise are never compared with each other
Heavy low-rep exposures are not compared with a later high-rep (>12) exposure of the same exercise
True positive preserved: four consecutive Straight Set exposures declining >5% still raise ACT
True positive preserved: three consecutive declining exposures raise INVESTIGATE
Legacy records with no intensifier/strengthMethod fields are still evaluated (as Straight Sets)
Mixed legacy and new-format records of the same exercise form one series
Top set + back-off on the same date: the top set represents the date, steady performance stays OBSERVE
Positive trend and insufficient data still return OBSERVE with unchanged messages
Structured intensifier records remain excluded from the engine
Several exercises: the most deteriorated comparable series is the one reported; a noisy one-off elsewhere is ignored
Zero/NaN/missing numeric fields and unknown shapes do not throw
Exercise names that collide with Object.prototype members do not throw
The engine is read-only: pa_hist is unchanged after evaluation
Joint status 1/5 with every other item 5/5 is not GREEN and says so
Joint status 2/5 with every other item 5/5 cannot be GREEN (capped at YELLOW, joint-qualified)
Joint status 3/4/5 with otherwise high scores remains GREEN with unchanged text
Numeric score is unchanged by the fix (override is classification-only)
Property check over all 3,125 inputs: label never improves, and is identical to the original rule whenever joints >= 3
Default (never checked-in) state is unchanged: 72, YELLOW
String, missing and garbage joint values follow the original defaults (unknown = 3, no override)
Other low readiness items alone do not trigger the joint override
UI: saving a check-in with Joint status 1/5 shows RED on the Readiness page and the Mission Status card
Coach Handoff reports the qualified label for a joint-flagged check-in
The override does not write or alter stored readiness data
